# Voice: speech in 23 languages with Chatterbox

Reads your script aloud in one of 23 languages. With a recording, it speaks in the voice of that recording. Without one, the voice node runs with no audio_prompt and uses the model's own voice. Built from Comfy's template audio-chatterbox_tts_multilingual.

## Models

- [t3_mtl23ls_v2.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox/resolve/5bb1f6ee58e50c3b8d408bc82a6d3740c2db6e18/t3_mtl23ls_v2.safetensors): Chatterbox Multilingual, by Resemble AI, [MIT](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox).
- [s3gen.pt](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox/resolve/5bb1f6ee58e50c3b8d408bc82a6d3740c2db6e18/s3gen.pt): Chatterbox Multilingual, by Resemble AI, [MIT](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox).
- [ve.pt](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox/resolve/5bb1f6ee58e50c3b8d408bc82a6d3740c2db6e18/ve.pt): Chatterbox Multilingual, by Resemble AI, [MIT](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox).
- [conds.pt](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox/resolve/5bb1f6ee58e50c3b8d408bc82a6d3740c2db6e18/conds.pt): Chatterbox Multilingual, by Resemble AI, [MIT](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox).

## Custom nodes

- [ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox](https://github.com/filliptm/ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox) at commit `f7d7a16187430abcaf91a3039b9c83aa9960816a`, MIT, per its README.

Rosesfield ships no weights. Each loader lists its file with a download link.

Part of [Rosesfield](https://github.com/rossaai/rosesfield), MIT. Built from Comfy-Org/workflow_templates, MIT, per NOTICE.
